description: Place the order. Only after the shopper has approved the total from update_checkout. With the shopper's Stripe shared payment token (spt_...), issued for at least the order total, JENNi charges it and places the order now. Never send card numbers. Delivered by JENNi. payment_token is optional. Without an spt_, call with only checkout_id: the result carries continue_url, the shopper's pay link, and the order is placed when they pay there. With a Link Agent Wallet, make a spend request (credential_type shared_payment_token, the network_id and amount_cents from this checkout's payment block) and pass the spt_ here.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same value to retry safely; the retry returns the first result instead of acting twice.

payment_token.description: Optional. Stripe shared payment token, starting spt_. Leave it out to get the shopper's pay link (continue_url).

name: complete_checkout

continue_url.description: Present when the shopper should finish on JENNi instead.

status.description: incomplete, ready_for_complete, requires_escalation, completed or canceled.

title: Place the order
